text:
Lucy Chen: Hey — I just opened a tiny PR to fix a flakey test and wanted to check I'm following our repo norms. quick questions: branch name, commit message style, and any local checks I should run before requesting review?

Devon Blake: Nice! Branching: feat/<ticket-number>-short-desc or fix/<ticket>-short-desc. e.g. fix/INC-342-flaky-cache.

Anjali Patel: Commit msgs follow conventional-ish style: <type>(scope): short summary. types = feat, fix, chore, docs, perf, test. scope is optional. e.g. fix(runtime): avoid stale kv-cache.

Lucy Chen: Perfect — we're using ticket numbers from Linear, right?

Devon Blake: Yup. Include the Linear/issue link in the PR description too.

Anjali Patel: Pre-PR checklist I run locally: 1) pre-commit hooks 2) unit tests for affected packages 3) run lint/format. Commands:
```bash
pre-commit run --all-files
make test-py
# or for a subset:
pytest services/runtime/tests/test_cache.py -q
```

Lucy Chen: Got it. Where's the PR template? I couldn't find it in the root.

Marco: It's under .github/pull_request_template.md. It has the reviewer suggestions + checklist. Quick copy: "- [ ] Add changelog entry if user-visible
- [ ] Add/Update tests
- [ ] Run pre-commit and lint"

Lucy Chen: Thanks — should I tag anyone specifically for runtime-related changes?

Devon Blake: Tag @anjali for infra/runtime and @sam for perf/latency changes. Also add the label area/runtime and label:needs-review.

Sam (oncall): If your change touches hot paths, run the small perf harness: scripts/bench/run_local.sh with sequence length 512 for a quick smoke. It takes ~2m.

Lucy Chen: Cool — I'll run that. One more: CI kept failing on my branch earlier with a mypy error I couldn't reproduce locally. Any tips?

Anjali Patel: We pin mypy in tox.ini. Run `tox -e py39-mypy` or `pip install -r dev-requirements.txt` then `mypy src/`. CI sometimes uses a newer plugin version; if CI shows a certain plugin path in the failure message, match it locally.

CI Bot: build/1726504321 — status: passed (lint, unit tests) :white_check_mark:

Lucy Chen: awesome, passing now. Sending small follow-up PR with fixes. thanks all! :smile:

Devon Blake: One tiny nit — include a short "why" in the PR body (what was flaky + how this fixes). helps backfills later.

Lucy Chen: will do. requesting review from @anjali and @devon in the PR now.

Anjali Patel: Looks good — will review after lunch.

Sam (oncall): LGTM on approach, leave perf label if you ran bench.

Lucy Chen: added area/runtime and perf-tested flag. thanks everyone!
